hooks.logic:
Set the next state to nothing.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If (the first member in the whole party where call helper with (member)) and util passes a fraction roll of 30, then set the next state to 21.
  Otherwise, the enemy picks and uses a weighted random move.
